item.title: Snap 0.4.1
item.description:
Snap v0.4.1 — changes since v0.4.0.
## Added
- feat: release.sh EdDSA-signs the build and publishes the Sparkle appcast - feat: clipboard search matcher + toolbar field (\#196) (\#220) - feat: add custom app icon and menu bar icon from stack assets
## Fixed
- fix: Show Desktop Icons force-terminates Finder so it auto-relaunches - fix: Preview sizes an image to its own size, fit to the screen - fix: Restyle the clipboard tag row, search, and cards to the reference (\#252) - fix: Card text hierarchy — larger title3 over subheadline, bigger preview (\#240) - fix: Rename the clipboard "All" chip to "Clipboard" (\#243) (\#249) - fix: Collapse tag chips to color-only when the clipboard search expands (\#242) (\#248) - fix: Center the search + debug icons in the clipboard bar (\#241) (\#247) - fix: Window-capture editor dims the area outside the captured window (\#239) (\#246) - fix: Desktop icons Show restores by deleting the CreateDesktop key (\#238) (\#245) - fix: Drag-into-report attaches the dragged card, not the selection (\#236) (\#244) - fix: Clipboard search empty-results state echoing the query (\#198) (\#235) - fix: Source app on the card, and the denylist (\#169) (\#234) - fix: Scroll-tracked neighbor thumbnail prefetch around the cursor (\#217) (\#233) - fix: Preview popover decodes its image once via a testable holder (\#216) (\#232) - fix: Warm first-screenful thumbnails in the background (\#215) (\#231) - fix: Off-main async card render with loading/broken placeholder (\#214) (\#230) - fix: Thumbnail cache + cards render cached downsampled thumbnails (\#213) (\#229) - fix: Downsampling thumbnail decoder + size math (pure foundation) (\#212) (\#228) - fix: Capture Window — pick overlay + camera cursor + menu row + editor integration (\#209) (\#227) - fix: Window capture core — enumeration seam + pick resolver + captureWindow (\#208) (\#226) - fix: Hide / Show Desktop Icons menu toggle (\#207) (\#225) - fix: Capture Fullscreen menu row — copy display under cursor to clipboard + history (\#206) (\#224) - fix: idle status menu as a testable value + icons + rename + reorder (\#205) (\#223) - fix: Sparkle + UpdateController seam + Check for Updates menu item (\#200) (\#222) - fix: clipboard search reveal-on-click + ⌘F/Esc keyboard (\#197) (\#221) - fix: center clipboard toolbar with trailing action zone (\#195) (\#219) - fix: enlarge clipboard thumbnails and card spacing (\#194) (\#218) - fix: enlarge clipboard cards to match the reference layout (\#191) (\#210) - fix: clipboard preview shows, points at the outlined card, and fits its content - fix: drag a selection into an open report (\#177) (\#190) - fix: action row with divider and bug icon that files a prefilled report (\#176) (\#189) - fix: Enter and Backspace over a selection (\#175) (\#188) - fix: multi-selection in the clipboard bar (\#174) (\#187) - fix: edit a text clip from the preview header (\#173) (\#186) - fix: preview a clip in a popover that follows the cursor (\#172) (\#185) - fix: read a copied URL as a link card showing its host (\#171) (\#184) - fix: remember copied text as text cards (\#170) (\#183) - fix: remember what you copy in other apps, images only (\#168) (\#182) - fix: teach a history entry what kind of thing it holds (\#167) (\#181) - fix: let a project row's tap and the list's drag coexist (\#166) (\#180) - fix: document the bar's chrome and the tag row within the existing budgets (\#154) (\#163) - fix: drag a card onto a tag pill to assign it (\#153) (\#162) - fix: right-click a card to tag it, with a Tags checklist and New Tag (\#152) (\#161) - fix: filter the strip by tag, with the one cursor kept single (\#151) (\#160) - fix: name a tag in place, cycle its colour, delete it (\#150) (\#159) - fix: a tag exists, persists across relaunch, and draws as a pill (\#149) (\#158) - fix: a card wears an accent band and a size pill (\#148) (\#156) - fix: the clipboard bar becomes a floating translucent slab (\#147) (\#155)
## Other
- Generate EdDSA keypair; bake public key into app; back up the private key (\#201) (\#250) - chore: add full brand kit and update agent steering doc - docs: add agent steering doc for icon assets - chore: add original stack icon assets to resources/icons/stack - Refactor/split test monolith (\#192) - chore: reference screenshots for \#191 (reference target) - chore: reference screenshots for \#191 (snap current) - docs: compress README's Features into links and route the detail to usage.md (\#165) (\#179) - docs: freeze the clipboard-manager PRD into docs/prds (\#164) (\#178) - Add bug report screenshot for \#157
